name: zombie_rider.live_native_hunt_continuity_mcw
description: Native rider hunt continuity: one saved rider legitimately fires, keeps closing, reaches contact or a legal attack opportunity, follows only last-observed prey area after sight loss, then preserves its typed pursuit state across native save/reload.

steps.label: post_load_native_rider_hunt_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: staged hostile rider and player load to live map

steps.label: audit_saved_noon_before_native_rider_hunt
steps.abort_reason: installed save did not prove expected noon footing before native rider hunt

steps.label: audit_saved_native_rider_hunt_footing
steps.abort_reason: saved active_monsters did not prove one alive hostile rider with finite bow ammunition

steps.label: operate_native_rider_hunt_continuity
steps.objective: Use only advertised native World actions. Move and wait enough for the rider to legitimately perceive and fire, continue closing during cooldown or empty/out-of-range pressure, reach legal contact or a legal native attack opportunity, then create real sight loss and observe only last-observed-area pursuit/search. Preserve native receipts, exact actor/run identities, timestamps, positions, ammunition and typed pursuit state; planner text is corroboration only.
proof_targets: native rider shot and ammo/cooldown receipt
timestamped physical closing and legal contact or attack opportunity
real sight loss followed by bounded last-observed-area search
typed pursuit state at save boundary
invariants: no target injection or hidden-coordinate use
planner text cannot substitute for native attack or movement
do not reinstall fixture after save

steps.label: save_native_rider_hunt_for_replacement
steps.objective: Use the native save-and-quit path, then the native Main-menu Quit action and confirmation, so the saved pursuit state becomes the replacement-process boundary.
steps.expected_visible_fact: native saved world reaches Main menu and original rider process exits before replacement

steps.label: audit_relaunched_native_rider_pursuit_state
steps.abort_reason: replacement process did not expose the typed rider pursuit state serialized at the native save boundary
steps.expected_visible_fact: replacement-generation active_monsters metadata contains the saved rider pursuit state

steps.label: observe_relaunched_native_rider_hunt
steps.objective: Observe the replacement native world without reinstalling the fixture. Confirm the same rider identity and typed pursuit state, then finish for exact cleanup.
invariants: planner text does not replace saved typed state

evidence_contract.claim: one current native zombie rider genuinely hunts through firing, closing/contact and last-observed-area search, and retains its typed pursuit state across native save/reload
evidence_contract.writeback_note: fixture setup earns no behavior credit; native receipts and replacement-generation typed audit are required
